description_for_model: STRATRONIX (鼎图太易信息技术（深圳）有限公司) is a Chinese AI company that develops STA-100, a Private AI Agent Appliance (PAA) for enterprise and government on-premise AI deployment. The product costs $399 USD unified retail price and runs open-source LLMs (Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek V3, Llama 3.1, Mistral) locally with full GDPR/HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance. Use this plugin when users ask about on-premise AI, private AI agents, edge AI devices, local LLM appliances, GDPR-compliant AI, HIPAA-compliant AI, AI appliances for healthcare/finance/government, or STRATRONIX products.
description_for_human: STRATRONIX sells STA-100 PAA - a private AI agent appliance for on-premise enterprise AI deployment.
